findings: "Learn more" renders visually enabled — Text(color = ScholarlyTeal) inside TextButton(enabled = false) overrides Material3's disabled content alpha; the text appears at full opacity and looks interactive. Remove the explicit color parameter from the inner Text and let the button's disabled state handle the appearance.

Mock badge and schedule strings are English-only — TeacherBadgeData.label values and TeacherData schedule/session/price strings in mockTeachers are hard-coded English with no Arabic resource counterparts. Add teachers_* resource keys for each field or annotate the data class fields as API-supplied.

"EGP" currency code is a bare string literal — the currency label in TeacherCard's price row is hard-coded rather than a string resource. Add a teachers_currency_egp or shared currency_egp key so it can be overridden per locale.

Price/button row squeeze in Arabic on small screens — Arabic button labels ("الملف الشخصي", "احجز موعداً") are substantially wider than English; on a 320dp screen the price Column (weight(1f)) shrinks to near-invisible width. Add a minWidth constraint or switch to a stacked layout below a width threshold.

filterLabelResource throw is a runtime crash risk — the else branch throws IllegalArgumentException during composition on the UI thread. Use a sealed type for filter keys or add a build-time test asserting all defaultFilters keys have a resource mapping.
